title: Unique and Personal Experience
text: I booked a three-way picnic for myself and two girl friends that were visiting from university. We actually ended up doing it at my house because of the rain and it was incredible! The owners went out of their way to make this happen as it was my friend's 30th birthday. We also had a cake from their cake provider and it was so yummy! You have to do this for a special occasion, it's totally worth it!
author: tripfluencerz

title: Beautiful Beach Picnic
text:
My husband and I were on our honeymoon in our favorite city and wanted to celebrate with something a little different. We love being by the beach so a romantic beach picnic was perfect for us. Straws n Berries set up a beautiful romantic picnic over looking the beach. It was private enough for us to enjoy each other’s company but also in the perfect location to soak up the atmosphere and buzz of the city. 
The set up was perfect, unique and chic. The food was tasty and had a wonderful variety of sweet and savory options - great for a warm summers evening. We couldn’t have asked for anything mo
